params.caption: 🕹️ Zelda edition gives Switch 2 its best sales week of 2026 Circana's Mat Piscatella says Switch 2 just had its strongest week of the year in US dollar sales, driven by the $520 Zelda 40th Anniversary Edition console. The bundle launched on October 29 alongside the Ocarina of Time remake, and the tracked week ended October 31. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 00:47 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot #Switch2 #Zelda #GamingNews
